probability_policy.rule: Do not assign priors or P(outcome|cause,test) from archival wording, intuition, symmetry, or convenience.
probability_policy.r4_2_connection: Use an R4.2-compatible deterministic outcome model with a minimax/no-prior adapter. The R4.2 expected-cost/outcome-probability layer is not authoritative for this benchmark.

global_invalid_states.OUT_OF_CONTRACT: Observed label/outcome was not preregistered. Do not reinterpret it post hoc; stop and amend a future preregistered protocol.
global_invalid_states.PROTOCOL_INVALID: A required control, preregistration, holdout, leakage exclusion, or instrument-validity condition failed. No cause-class promotion is permitted.
